title: E-VIVLIO
description: A collaborative e-reading ecosystem. Shared shelves, shared notes, shared pages — readers stay in sync and in conversation around the same book, so reading stops being a solo act.

title: YARD
description: Free, ad-free music with real-time listening sync (beta). Open a room, press play, and everyone hears the same second of the same song together — sync over WebSockets, playback over Web Audio.

title: COVE
description: No account, no download, no friction — just a room code. Real-time voice chat and screen sharing straight in the browser, built on WebRTC.

title: THIS PORTFOLIO
description: The site you're reading. Adapted from Cyprien Jaquier's open-source Vue portfolio, then rewritten, re-skinned and extended by me — the lab where my WebGL, Web Audio and WebSockets experiments eventually ship.
